title: #411 Second Language
prompt: What is your opinion on the importance of learning a second language?

promptSegments.text: What is your opinion on the importance of learning a second language?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Learning a second language allows people to communicate with more people, opening up opportunities to meet new friends and understand local customs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, studying a second language helps people understand other cultures, providing a new perspective on different ways of life and traditions.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, studying a second language helps people understand other cultures, providing a new perspective on different ways of life and traditions.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Learning a second language is not essential for daily life or career success.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning a second language is not essential for daily life or career success.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay provides reasons why native language skills are sufficient for communication and job performance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay provides reasons why native language skills are sufficient for communication and job performance.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Learning a second language is important because it helps people travel and because it improves job prospects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning a second language is important because it helps people travel and because it improves job prospects.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Specific structures (PEEL) and limited vocabulary to maintain a B2 level while meeting all structural requirements.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Specific structures (PEEL) and limited vocabulary to maintain a B2 level while meeting all structural requirements.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Focusing too much on language rules can neglect essential practical life skills, such as budgeting or managing money, which are equally important.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Focusing too much on language rules can neglect essential practical life skills, such as budgeting or managing money, which are equally important.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, the pressure to achieve perfect proficiency in a second language can cause anxiety and even develop a fear of speaking, making self-confidence more crucial.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, the pressure to achieve perfect proficiency in a second language can cause anxiety and even develop a fear of speaking, making self-confidence more crucial.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.

promptTraps.en: Avoid memorized generic templates; ensure every body paragraph contains concrete reasoning and evidence.

faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
